For any two integers j and k, if both are odd, their product jk is odd. This is because any odd number can be written as 2n + 1. The product of two odd numbers (2n+1) and (2m+1) is (2n+1) * (2m+1) = 4nm + 2n + 2m + 1. Since 4nm is always even, and adding any even number to an odd number results in an odd number, the product (2n+1) * (2m+1) is odd. This conclusion is verified by a simple Python function that checks if both numbers are odd and returns whether their product is odd.
